message.content:
In Blackjack, an Ace is a “soft” card – it can be worth **either 1 or 11 points**, whichever makes your hand stronger without going over 21.  
- If treating the Ace as 11 keeps you ≤ 21, you’ll usually count it as 11.  
- If counting it as 11 would bust you, you automatically switch it to 1.  

So the Ace’s value is dynamic: it starts as 11, but flips to 1 when needed to keep the hand from exceeding 21.
